name: @javierfrancoleal/fanal-cockpit-browser
description: The DOCTRINE of Fanal's cockpit browser — the Claude Cowork-style internal browser that lives in Fanal's desktop Electron shell (apps/desktop/main.js), NOT in DeepSeek Harness. A host-only skill that teaches the agent the six pillars: the persistent encrypted session (persist:fanal-client-workspace + Keychain/DPAPI), the double isolation (no file:// in, no bytes out), the constitutional brake (the agent fills, the human clicks the final button), the 36px HUD (⚡ AGENTE / 🖐️ VOLANTE HUMANO / 🛑 FRENO), the dual-monitor without data loss, and the golden rule.
author: J.Franco
